vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: healthkit-code-review
Version: 1.2.0

The skill bundle is a legitimate tool designed to assist in reviewing iOS HealthKit implementations. It contains structured checklists and reference documentation (authorization.md, background.md, queries.md, data-types.md) that highlight common developer errors and best practices. There is no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection; the instructions are strictly aligned with the stated purpose of code review.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only HealthKit code-review checklist with embedded references and requests no credentials, installs, or system access — its requirements match its stated purpose.

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only HealthKit code-review checklist and reference set; it does not request credentials or install code. Before installing, consider: (1) it will analyze any code you pass to the agent — don't send production secrets or private data you don't want reviewed, (2) the guidance is best-practice advice, not an automated security guarantee — manually verify important changes, and (3) the skill can be invoked by the agent (platform default). If you need stricter control, restrict when the skill may be called or review its outputs before acting on them.
